name: Starlink Group 15-27
slot_a_text: B1093 on its 17th flight. Perfect 16 for 16 on landings. Last flew Starlink Group 17-38 42 days ago. Targeting the drone ship Of Course I Still Love You, 574 km downrange.
slot_b_text: 60 launches from SLC-4E so far this year. 297 in total since it opened. It turns around in about 3 days.
description: A batch of 27 satellites for the Starlink mega-constellation - SpaceX's project for space-based Internet communication system.
program_description: Starlink is a satellite internet constellation operated by American aerospace company SpaceX
rocket_fact: The Falcon 9's engines are arranged in an 'Octaweb' pattern to contain blast damage.
